column1: # nativeps5 Metal presence manifest: for every (row key, GPU class) of our custom Metal rows, `ship` (the list must carry it) or `off:<reason>` (why not).
# HASHES AND WORDS ONLY. tests/test_metal_expected.py fails when a ship row is missing from the list, a list row is missing here, or a row of the
# previous release disappears without a reason. Update after a list change: python3 scripts/nps5lib/metalexpected.py update <game id> (see its --help text).
# Seeded 2026-11-27 from the list at HEAD, the tags v1.2 to v1.4.3, tests/data/valfix_dropped.tsv, the list's own kk rows and the M6 timing flags.
# Reasons: slower-<class> (kk row or M6 timing not faster), dropped-correctness:<commit> (valfix 9d9b5ca, shipgate b66a26e), mesh-pending, candidate-g18 (faster on M6, no g18 row yet),
# untested-<class> (no timing or validation on that class), replaced-or-moved (an older tag shipped it; a faster mode or a re-keyed alias row serves it now).
